requirements.text: Password authentication accepts configured record credentials and returns an authenticated response before CRUD.
List and view deny nil rules to non-superusers and apply non-empty rules to authenticated records.
Create denies nil CreateRule and rejects data that fails a non-empty CreateRule.
Update denies nil UpdateRule and refetches through non-empty UpdateRule.
Delete denies nil DeleteRule and fetches through non-empty DeleteRule before deletion.
